Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 200/2024

Dear Ms. Rao,

Thank you for meeting us on 4 April 2025 about your dispute with Karve Industries. As we understand it, the employer withheld the last salary. The matter is listed before the Surat Labour Court.

Our advice is to file a claim for unpaid wages before the labour authority. Please collect the attendance record and the salary slips and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 51,50,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
